0022600113.text: The Indiana Pacers (1-1, 9th in the East, 3rd in the Central and 1 game back) visit the Brooklyn Nets (0-2, 12th in the East, 5th in the Atlantic and 2.5 games back) in the Pacers' third game of the 2026-27 season, with Brooklyn having lost its last two. Indiana is missing Ben Sheppard (knee), Johnny Furphy (knee, surgery) and T.J. McConnell (hamstring), while Aaron Nesmith is day-to-day with a hamstring strain and is a game-time decision, and Brooklyn is without Mikel Brown Jr. (rest) and Tyler Bilodeau (shoulder). The Pacers won the 2025-26 season series 2-1 and beat the Nets 123-94 in Brooklyn on April 9, 2026, and the teams have not yet met this season.
